title: At the Supermarket
summary: A customer asks for help finding products at the supermarket and learns vocabulary for common food items.
description: A short shopping scenario between a customer and a shop assistant. Focuses on countable/uncountable nouns (a bottle of, a kilo of) and polite requests.

vocabulary.definition: the long passage between the shelves in a supermarket
the container and the liquid inside it, for example water
a unit of weight equal to one thousand grams
the place in a store where you pay

dialogue.text: Excuse me. Where can I find the milk?
The milk is in aisle three, on the right.
The apples are next to the milk. Do you need a bag?
Yes, please. I also want a bottle of water.
The water is in aisle one. Anything else?
Yes. A kilo of rice, please.
Rice is in aisle five. The checkout is at the end of the aisle.

questions.q: What does the customer buy a kilo of?

options: At the end of the aisle

trueFalse.statement: The water is in aisle three.
trueFalse.explanation: The shop assistant says the water is in aisle one.

trueFalse.statement: The customer asks for a bag.
trueFalse.explanation: The customer says 'Do you need a bag? — Yes, please.'

teacherTips: Bring (or print) small pictures of common food items before the listening activity.
Practise 'Excuse me' and 'Thank you' as fixed classroom phrases for student–student role plays.
After listening, learners design a simple shopping list and role-play the dialogue in pairs.

es.title: En el supermercado
es.summary: Un cliente pide ayuda para encontrar productos en el supermercado y aprende vocabulario de alimentos comunes.
es.description: Una situación corta de compras entre un cliente y un dependiente. Se centra en sustantivos contables/incontables (a bottle of, a kilo of) y peticiones corteses.

vocabulary.definition: el pasillo largo entre las estanterías de un supermercado
el envase y el líquido que contiene, por ejemplo agua
una unidad de peso equivalente a mil gramos
el lugar de la tienda donde se paga
se usa para preguntar por el precio

questions.q: ¿De qué compra el cliente un kilo?

trueFalse.statement: El agua está en el pasillo tres.
trueFalse.explanation: El dependiente dice que el agua está en el pasillo uno.
El cliente dice 'Do you need a bag? — Yes, please'.

teacherTips: Lleva (o imprime) imágenes pequeñas de alimentos comunes antes de la actividad de escucha.
Practica 'Excuse me' y 'Thank you' como frases fijas de aula para role-plays entre estudiantes.
Después de escuchar, los estudiantes diseñan una lista de la compra sencilla y hacen el role-play por parejas.
